name: Fauser Stadl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Fauser Stadl in Serfaus**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. At **Fauser Stadl**, we invite you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Schlutzkrapfen**, and crispy **Speckknödel**, all crafted with local ingredients. Enjoy our cozy atmosphere, perfect for a warm meal after a day on the slopes or a relaxing break in the mountains.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Serfaus** offers breathtaking scenery and world-class skiing. Whether you're here for adventure or relaxation, **Fauser Stadl** is your home away from home in the **Tirol**.
